# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VWAP_RSI_BULLISH_DIVERGENCE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In the midday session (10:30-14:00 ET), a bullish RSI divergence occurring at VWAP support indicates a high-probability long setup. This edge exists because midday liquidity provides cleaner mean-reversion signals, and VWAP acts as dynamic support/resistance while RSI divergence signals weakening momentum and potential reversal.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Time: 10:30-14:00 ET. If low[0] within 0.1% of VWAP[0] AND RSI[0] > RSI[2] (bullish divergence) AND close[0] > open[0] (bullish bar) AND low[0] is lowest low of last 5 bars, enter long at close[0].  
**Exit:** Initial stop placed below recent swing low (defined as lowest low of last 10 bars minus $0.01). TP1: sell 2/3 of position at entry + 1R (risk = entry - stop). Remaining 1/3 trailed by 20% off HWM (stop = max(previous stop, HWM * 0.80)). Exit remaining if price closes below trailing stop.  
**Regime filter:** Requires VIX > 18 and rising (indicating mean-reversion propensity). Avoids first/last 30 minutes for liquidity.
